Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Official Announcement Trailer
Here's your look at the Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest announcement trailer for this upcoming turn-based RPG inspired by the Warrior Cats novel series. Hunt prey, hone your skills, and defend your home against rival warriors as you rise through the ranks of your Clan. Experience previously untold stories of the Warrior Cats world and build a legacy that will last a lifetime. Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest will be available on PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 in fall 2026.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Take-Two Defends GTA 6 Digital-Only Launch - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
GTA 6 publisher Take-Two has defended the move to launch the game digital-only. CEO Strauss Zelnick, however, did not rule out the possibility of a physical release in the future, but for now it just make more sense to release the game digitally, especially considering consumer buying habits. In related news, Nintendo reports that nearly 40% of their software sales are physical, proving yet again that the company and their die-hard fans go against the grain compared to the rest of the gaming industry. And finally, Spider-Man: Brand New Day has set a new domestic box office record, crossing $500 million in U.S. ticket sales in one week. The previous record-holder is Avengers: Endgame, which still holds the record for fastest to $1 billion ticket sales globally.

Join the development team at Alkimia Studios for a message about Gothic 1 Remake, including what you can expect from future updates for the remake of the classic RPG, like bug fixes, polishing, and features planned like photo mode, Marvin Mode, alternative progression, and mod support.
